result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make **a dignified life a universal guarantee rather than a privilege**: enough food, housing, healthcare, and education for everyone, with no one beneath that line.

Not as charity—as a foundation for freedom. Desperation makes people easier to exploit and less able to resist. It wouldn’t erase cruelty, but it would remove one of humanity’s most powerful engines.

A world where nobody has to sell their dignity just to survive.
